Hi Jon,

I'm sorry. You asked for swap options on October 29 and all you got back was "the team will follow up", twice. That shouldn't have happened, especially when you've been waiting on this order since September 8. Here are the options now.

Your Bitfortun BS-2 was delivered on September 25. The only thing still open is the Nexus L1, which you paid $399.99 for. These are the units I can swap it for today:

Hammer Miner DC06 (330 MH/s), $379.99. This is the closest match, since it mines the same coins as the L1 at about the same hashrate. It's in stock and ships within 2 business days. Because it costs less, $20.00 goes back to your original payment method. It's sold as Final Sale.

Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10 TH/s), $349.00. This one mines Bitcoin rather than Litecoin or Doge. It's in stock and ships within 2 business days. The $50.99 difference would come back as store credit on your account, which you can use at checkout on your next order.

Bitfortun BS-4 (18 TH/s), $599.99. This is a step up for Bitcoin, but it's a pre-order that ships from the manufacturer by Nov 30, 2026. You would pay a $200.00 difference, and we'd email you an invoice for it.

Just reply with the one you want and I'll make the change on this same order. You'll get the updated order confirmation by email.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
